backups.title: Database backups
backups.note: The backup service makes the backups: an encrypted (AES-256) database dump and a media archive every night, plus a database dump before each deploy. Daily backups are kept for 30 days, then one per week for a year, then one per month indefinitely. If no new backup appears, the operators get an email. On the server, "docker compose exec backup tail /var/log/backup.log" shows the recent runs, and "scripts/restore_drill.sh" tests a restore.
